title: Genotype and RNA integration with cis eQTL mapping in simulated breast cancer
author: Vusumuzi Mabasa
disclosure: All participants, genes, positions, LD and subtype labels are synthetic. No protein, somatic or copula layer in this experiment. No clinical or public breast cancer data were analysed.
primary_qtl: Twelve gene-level omnibus tests of the four cis genotype main effects and four genotype by subtype interactions jointly, followed by BH within each cohort.
interaction_qtl: Twelve separate gene-level genotype by subtype interaction tests, BH within cohort, not joint control across the two families.
association_truth: Gene-level effect presence, not whether each LD-correlated tag SNP is directly causal.
integration_selection: MOFA selects K by training-only masked genotype/RNA reconstruction and starts by training ELBO. DIABLO tunes components and keepX by stratified threefold training-only balanced accuracy. Both see the same molecular participants and clinical covariates; test outcomes never tune models.
simulation_policy: Freeze scientific sources before evaluation. Preserve all previous outputs. Record failures and warnings; do not alter effect sizes, seeds or model grids after inspecting performance. Software corrections require a recorded amendment and rerun affected evaluations.
